method.method_draft: Use Bretschneider's formula for a quadrilateral. From the image/text order, the consecutive side lengths are PQ=11, QR=7, RS=9, SP=3, and the right angles are at opposite vertices P and R. The semiperimeter is s=(11+7+9+3)/2=15. Bretschneider's formula gives K^2=(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)(s-d)-abcd cos^2((A+C)/2), where A and C are opposite angles. Since angles P and R are both 90°, their sum is 180°, so cos^2(90°)=0. Thus K=sqrt((15-11)(15-7)(15-9)(15-3))=sqrt(4·8·6·12)=48 cm^2.
